title: Recommended water and beverage intake for children

source.title: МР 2.3.1.0253-21. Нормы физиологических потребностей в энергии и пищевых веществах для различных групп населения Российской Федерации
source.authority: Федеральная служба по надзору в сфере защиты прав потребителей и благополучия человека
source.tableTitle: Рекомендуемое потребление воды и напитков для поддержания водного баланса организма детей

infantContext.sourceStatementSemantic: For infants in the first months of life, water need is met from breast milk; before complementary feeding a healthy child does not need additional fluid.

scope.foodWaterContext: The source states that water obtained with food contributes approximately 40-60% depending on age/diet.

reviewNotes: The 7-11 month value is a recommended intake of water and beverages, not a total fluid requirement in ml/kg/day.
The nonnumeric pre-complementary-feeding statement is retained as context and is not converted into a universal zero-fluid clinical rule.
Illness, dehydration, fever, environmental heat, formula preparation, and therapeutic fluid calculations are outside this table's contract.
Keep this dataset separate from Holliday-Segar/maintenance-fluid calculators and oral-rehydration treatment.
